known.note: Codefied Inc. does business as Housecall Pro (Form Ds 2013-2022, Gieselmann director; merged). HQ Denver (the firm's CMS and the 2022 Form D, 4180 Wynkoop Street); founded in San Diego. TechCrunch (2014-01-16): Housecall 'has raised $1.5 million from investors, including e.ventures', which matches the first Form D (Codefied Inc., first sale 2013-07-26, $1.5M, Thomas Gieselmann of e.ventures as director) and CMS 'Early 2013'. The Seed label is inferred (first outside money for a six-person startup); no page names the round. The next rounds (Form D $7.6M in 2015, $11.0M in 2017) carry no series label in any source found, so the next priced round is uncited.
